sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders come into this fixture in excellent form, having won their last game and recording five consecutive wins before that. Alsager Town arrive in poor shape at the bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches and are winless in their last five outings, making them unlikely to trouble the in-form table-toppers.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way; Stafford have picked up decent recent form with a draw in their last outing. AFC Bridgnorth, third and unbeaten in five games, host Eccleshall in a battle between two of the division's stronger sides, with Eccleshall looking to bounce back after a recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community in a local clash between mid-table teams, with Casuals on a recent win and Wednesfield showing mixed form. In-form Bilston Town (five games unbeaten) entertain Foley Meir at home on Saturday. Barnton host Shawbury United in a fixture between two teams seeking consistent form; Shawbury sit in the relegation zone after a run of five straight losses despite one recent win. Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills, with both teams struggling to find consistency in mid-table. Crewe face Allscott Heath in a clash between sides battling inconsistency, while at the bottom, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a fixture between two of the league's weakest performers. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, with the latter bottom of the table winless from seven games.
